# Snes9x playback core

Unmodified 64-bit Windows Snes9x libretro core, copied from the existing research core downloaded from the official Libretro buildbot. Used in an isolated headless worker for audio previews. The opened ROM is read only; the worker uses a temporary snapshot and private emulator RAM. It never reads or writes player save files.

Documentation: https://docs.libretro.com/library/snes9x/
Corresponding project/source: https://github.com/libretro/snes9x
Build source: https://buildbot.libretro.com/nightly/windows/x86_64/latest/snes9x_libretro.dll.zip

See LICENSE for the complete notices and non-commercial-use terms. No ROM, ripped soundtrack, or game assets are bundled here.

Bundled core reports: Snes9x 1.63 fae2fea.
